verses.1: For the redemption of David from his enemies.
verses.2: Save me, O God! For they have come from the waters up to my very soul.
verses.3: I was caught in a stormy wind; I couldn’t stand in the depths of the sea. The waves washed over me.
verses.4: I was pained by the sight of Nihar Groni; my eyes were filled with tears.
verses.5: I hate those who are arrogant and proud. They have destroyed themselves through their own actions. They are false people who did not steal anything from others. So, I will respond to them accordingly.
verses.6: God, you know all about my sins. My faults do not remain hidden from you.
verses.7: Do not harm me, O Lord God of Israel! Do not deceive me. I seek the help of the God of Israel.
verses.8: For you have brought upon yourself shame; your face is covered with disgrace.
verses.9: I was a foreigner to my brothers, and an outsider to my mother’s children.
verses.10: Because your jealousy has caused me to be eaten by you, and your insults have fallen upon me.
verses.11: And I was consumed by sorrow, and it became a source of pain for me.
verses.12: And I gave them a bag, and I made it their possession.
verses.13: They will sit in the gates, and the sounds of the harps will be heard.
verses.14: I pray to you, LORD, at the time of God’s desire, in your great kindness. I truly hope that you will save me.
verses.15: Save me from destruction and from those who hate me, from the depths of the sea.
verses.16: Do not drown me with water, and do not swallow me by the waves. Do not let me fall into the depths of the sea.
verses.17: O LORD, answer me! For your kindness is great, and your mercy is abundant. Turn to me!
verses.18: And do not hide your face from your servant, for I am eager to answer you.
verses.19: May she come to my soul, so that my enemies may be freed from me.
verses.20: You know my humiliation and my suffering. All my troubles are against you.
verses.21: It’s a shame that my heart was broken, and I became sad and sorrowful. I searched for comfort, but I couldn’t find it at all.
verses.22: And they gave me a head and a tail; they covered me with dirt.
verses.23: May they be sent before them, as a warning and a reminder for those who are to be punished.
verses.24: Their eyes become blind from seeing, and their offerings are always worthless.
verses.25: Pour your wrath upon them; may your anger bring them down.
verses.26: May their tent be filled with souls, so that no one may sit in it.
verses.27: For you, who have been pursued and driven to a miserable fate, your enemies will tell tales about you.
verses.28: May they suffer punishment for their actions, and may they not enter your justice.
verses.29: Let them not be listed among the living, nor should they be written down along with the righteous.
verses.30: I am poor and suffering. May your help, O God, be with me.
verses.31: Let us praise the name of God with songs, and let us glorify it with praises.
verses.32: And it shall be pleasing to the LORD from the mouth of Par Makrin Mafris.
verses.33: May those who are poor rejoice, and may the servants of God be happy.
verses.34: For Jehovah hears his fathers, and he does not release his captives.
verses.35: May heaven and earth, and all creatures in them, praise Him.
verses.36: For God will save Zion and build the cities of Judah, and people will dwell there and inherit them.
verses.37: And the seeds of his servants will be sown there, and those who love his name will dwell there.
